name: Puzzle Infrastructure
description:
A puzzle's victory conditions are determined by blocks in the puzzle itself. To win a puzzle, a blue +1 charge must get to a judgment stone.
If it receives a red -1 charge, you lose the puzzle. You can create your own puzzles using the sandbox.
goal: Place a judgment stone and give it a positive charge.

textBoxes.text:
A puzzle's victory conditions are determined by blocks in the puzzle itself.
To win a puzzle, a +1 charge must get to a Judgment Stone.
If it receives a -1 charge instead, you will lose the puzzle.
You can create your own puzzles using the sandbox.
